name: Jasch Industries Limited
about: Jasch Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of coated textiles and synthetic leathers in India, North America, South Africa, and Europe. It operates in two segments, Synthetic Leather & Allied Products P.V.C, and Synthetic Leather & Allied Products P.U. The company offers vinyl coated, polyurethane (PU), and semi-PU coated fabrics are used in automotive, contract upholstery, footwear, leather manufacturer, sports, technical garments, healthcare, and polymeric films and breathable membranes; PU resins, including component PU adhesive, component PU for dry process, and polyester polyols; and industrial gauges. The company was formerly known as Jasch Polymers Ltd and changed its name to Jasch Industries Limited in September 1993. Jasch Industries Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in New Delhi, India.
